activity.notes: Harold Holt was sworn in as Australia's 17th Prime Minister on 26 January 1966. National Archives of Australia and the official prime-ministerial transcript archive give his period of service through 19 December 1967, when he was officially pronounced dead after disappearing while swimming.

sources.title: Harold Holt — National Archives of Australia
sources.citation_text: The National Archives identifies Holt as Australia's 17th Prime Minister, in office from 26 January 1966 to 19 December 1967.

sources.title: PM Transcripts — Harold Holt
sources.citation_text: The official Australian prime-ministerial transcript archive lists Holt's period of service as 26 January 1966 to 19 December 1967.
